$comment: Curated half of design-system/tokens.json: what each token is for, the text styles, the contrast pairs to report and the theme notes. The VALUES come from the stylesheets; tools/design-tokens.js merges the two. A token added to microtone.css without a note here (or a trailing comment there) fails test/node/design-system.test.js.

themes.dark: Slate and amber, after taut.js. What :root declares, so a page without data-theme draws in it.
themes.dim: Neutral grey midway between dark and light; the theme the app boots into.
themes.light: Light grounds; every accent re-mixed darker (amber becomes burnt orange).
themes.warmth: The Analogue Warmth Edition: beige moulded plastic, with the texture tokens on top. Joins the theme cycle only while in season and is never saved.

usage.bg: App background, the ground under every view; also the active tab's fill so it joins the view below it.
usage.panel: Bars and panels: top bar, status bar, pane heads, toolbox, command palette, modals and menus.
usage.panel-2: Raised controls on a panel: buttons, inputs, value controls, inactive tabs, the highlighted menu cell.
usage.fg: Primary text and note glyphs, on bg, panel and panel-2. Clears 7:1 on every ground in every theme.
usage.fg2: Key-off glyphs in the grid; kept clearly brighter than dim so key-offs never read as empty cells.
usage.dim: Secondary text: hints, captions, inactive tabs, empty grid cells, the step buttons of a value control. On bg and panel, at 0.82rem or larger; not on panel-2, where it misses 4.5:1 in most themes (see contrast).
usage.accent: Amber in the dark themes, burnt orange on light grounds: focus and hover borders, the active tab and tool, palette labels, sentinels and off-grid notes, and the Proceed button's fill (proceed-bg). Also the accent-color of every native checkbox, radio and slider. In warmth it is weak on bg; use it on panel or panel-2 there.
usage.accent-2: Cyan-blue: the instrument column, links, pan ticks and the selection-mode chip.
usage.meter: Green: VU bars, the volume column and live dots.
usage.meter-bg: Meter troughs and the idle ring of the loading spinner.
usage.cv-gonio: Yellow: the dots of a goniometer (the Mixing tab's). Kept off meter green because the correlation bar under the cloud is green, and the two must not read as one thing.
usage.border: Every 1px hairline: control outlines, bar rules, pane seams, menu dividers. Below the 3:1 control-border floor in every theme as shipped, so a state is carried by the accent border, never by border alone.
usage.ok-fg: Text of the 'audio on' badge, on ok-bg.
usage.err-bg: Ground of the 'audio off' badge and of warnings.
usage.err-fg: Text of the 'audio off' badge and warnings, on err-bg; also the clip-lamp ink on the Mastering canvas.
usage.rec-fg: Record armed: the dot, the label and the hover border of the armed button. Weakest on rec-bg in dim; there it always rides with the record dot icon.
usage.rec-border: Record armed: the button's resting border.
usage.cv-bg: Canvas ground for waveforms, envelopes and the splash grid.
usage.cv-row-beat: Pattern grid: the primary beat row band.
usage.cv-row-bar: Pattern grid: the secondary beat (bar) row band.
usage.cv-playhead: Pattern grid: the row that is playing.
usage.cv-caret: Pattern grid: the sub-column caret in record mode (amber family).
usage.cv-caret-nav: Pattern grid: the sub-column caret in navigate mode (blue family).
usage.cv-cue-line: Pattern grid: the rule between cues.
usage.cv-col-pan: Pattern grid: pan column ink; also the effect ink in the splash grid.
usage.cv-ditto: Pattern grid: ghost cells repeated by a pattern ditto.
usage.cv-fx-op: Effect column: the opcode letter (and an S/Z sub-command nibble).
usage.cv-fx-ext: Effect column: a ':' extension cell and the cell it pairs with.
usage.cv-oct-red: Register ramp stop 1 (the bottom of the keyboard). The ramp is ordered by hue only; it colours a 2px register stripe, never text.
usage.cv-oct-blue: Register ramp stop 4 (the top of the keyboard).
usage.cv-pitch-pole: Absolute-pitch plot: the rose ticks and the contour joining them, a hue nothing else in the cells wears.
usage.cv-pitch-axis: Absolute-pitch plot: the neutral centre rule behind the ticks.
usage.cv-wave-invert: Loop bytes the invert loop (S $F0xx) has inverted live.
usage.cv-wave-funk: Where funk repeat (Z $F0xx) has walked the loop to.
usage.cv-play-cursor: Envelope nodes and live envelope markers.
usage.cv-wave-cursor: Live play-position hairline over a waveform; hot pink so it never disappears into the trace or a modified byte.
usage.cv-pool-used: Sample-memory panel: bytes a sample claims.
usage.cv-pool-shared: Sample-memory panel: bytes more than one census row claims.
usage.cv-pool-stale: Sample-memory panel: unclaimed space still holding old audio.
usage.cv-pool-region: Pool map: a long recording loaded into memory.
usage.cv-pool-c0: Pool-map block cycle 1 of 5 (blue). Neighbouring blocks take consecutive entries, so the order matters more than the set.
usage.cv-pool-c4: Pool-map block cycle 5 of 5: separates by lightness, not hue (pale on dark grounds, near-black on light).
usage.brand: The wordmark's red half ('Micro') and the mark's ink.
usage.brand2: The wordmark's second half ('tone'), near-white on dark grounds and slate on light ones.
usage.scrim: The veil behind a modal, and behind the manual's contents drawer on a phone; one neutral black for every theme.
usage.proceed-bg: The Proceed button's fill: the one action a dialog is for (components/actions.js). The theme's accent, so 'the one that will happen' wears the hue that already means 'this one'.
usage.proceed-fg: The Proceed button's label, on proceed-bg; set at weight-proceed.
usage.proceed-hover: The Proceed button's fill under the pointer: a step further from proceed-fg than proceed-bg.
usage.code-bg: Motif editor: the page under the code (the Dimtello grey in the dark themes, the Syntello white in the light ones).
usage.code-fg: Motif editor: plain code text and the caret.
usage.code-caret-row: Motif editor: the band behind the caret's line.
usage.code-sel: Motif editor: the selection, drawn under the text (motifmarks.js).
usage.code-occ-read: Motif editor: other occurrences of the name under the caret, where it is read.
usage.code-occ-write: Motif editor: other occurrences of the name under the caret, where it is written.
usage.code-gutter-bg: Motif editor: the line-number gutter's ground.
usage.code-gutter-here: Motif editor: the caret line's number.
usage.code-decl: Motif editor: declaration keywords — song, instrument, lane, section (bold).
usage.code-esc: Motif editor: escapes inside a string.
usage.code-fn: Motif editor: function calls; builtins in italic.
usage.code-fn-decl: Motif editor: a function's name where it is declared.
usage.code-name: Motif editor: names given to music (italic).
usage.code-err: Motif editor: the line number of an error (bold).
usage.abs-grain: Warmth only: the fine grain moulded into the case, laid over every bar and panel.
usage.abs-bevel: Warmth only: the highlight-and-shade pair that makes an edge look bevelled.
usage.abs-cap: Warmth only: a membrane keycap at rest — the fill of every button.
usage.abs-cap-down: Warmth only: a membrane keycap pressed.
usage.radius-sm: Inputs, selects, badges, chips, find-bar fields, wheelable readouts.
usage.radius-md: Buttons, value controls, context-menu cells, the splash grid; tabs take it on their top corners only.
usage.radius-lg: Modals, context menus, the meters canvas, drop zones.
usage.weight-proceed: The Proceed button's label. At least weight-button + 200: the rule is the difference, not the number.
usage.cv-font: Motif Grid: the tracker grids, the chord and notation makers, the keymap, and every note written as a symbol (noteglyph.js).
usage.mono-font: Motif Mono: what is typed or read as a value — hex and number fields, indexes, readouts, key names, canvas labels (fonts.js canvasMonoFont).
usage.transport-font: Motif Transport: the transport readouts (Oct, Inst, Step, Cue, Row, BPM, Spd), 10% narrower.
usage.code-font: Motif Code: the Motif editor and its panels, the manual's code.

styles.name: wordmark-hero
styles.usage: The welcome screen hero (.wc-brand). Geist 900 oblique; Micro in brand, tone in brand2.

styles.name: wordmark-bar
styles.usage: The top-bar brand that opens About (.brand-container); 1.7rem inside the About modal.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Default button label at weight-button; 1.1rem for button.big. Open Sans at wdth 86.67 with tabular figures, as everywhere in the chrome.

styles.name: proceed
styles.usage: The Proceed button's label: weight-proceed, 200 heavier than every other button, on proceed-bg.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Projects live in your browser’s private storage.
styles.usage: Prose in modals (.modal-text p) and the welcome tagline.

styles.name: compact
styles.usage: Status bar, badges, toolbox and command-palette buttons, find bar fields; wdth 96.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Palette hints and secondary links, set in dim.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Palette and find-bar row labels, set in accent.

styles.name: menu-cell
styles.usage: Context-menu cell captions under a 30px icon.

styles.name: grid
styles.usage: The tracker grids (canvas pattern cells), the chord and notation makers, the keymap: Motif Grid, which draws every accidental, tick, slide mark and sentinel as a character.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Typed hex and number values, indexes and inline readouts: Motif Mono.

styles.name: transport
styles.usage: The transport readouts in the top bar: Motif Transport, everything 10% narrower.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The Motif editor and the manual's code: Motif Code, where i I l are narrower and M m W w wider, and bold and italic keep the roman's advances.

touchUsage.row-beat: Grid: the primary beat row band (the tracker's cv-row-beat).
touchUsage.row-bar: Grid: the secondary beat (bar) row band (the tracker's cv-row-bar).
touchUsage.row-play: Grid: the row that is playing (the tracker's cv-playhead).
touchUsage.cursor: Grid: the cursor cell, and a pressed chip (the tracker's cv-cursor).
touchUsage.fx-ink: Grid: the effect tag on a cell (the tracker's cv-fx-op).
touchUsage.key-natural: Keyboard: the fill of a natural key.
touchUsage.key-near: Keyboard: the fill of a key one inflection from a natural (a Kite tick, a demisharp or demiflat).
touchUsage.key-accidental: Keyboard: the fill of an accidental key.
touchUsage.key-edge: Keyboard: the 1px edge round every key.
touchUsage.key-tonic: Keyboard: the 3px edge round the tonic.
touchUsage.key-down: Keyboard: a key held down (the accent).
touchUsage.key-ghost: Keyboard: the ring on a key the song is playing.
touchUsage.lane-0: Lane 1's hue: its header, its cells' note ink and its keys' label. One hue per lane; neighbours differ in hue AND lightness.
touchUsage.note-font: Motif Grid: every note Touch spells, on the keys, in the grid and in the effect sheet's title.
touchUsage.gap: The gap between grid cells and bar controls.
